name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible behavior or metric error

---

Describe the observed and expected behavior.

Include a minimal synthetic JSONL example, command, toolkit/Python versions,
and sanitized output. Do not include private data, API keys, or provider headers.

For metric bugs, include the expected calculation and missing-reference behavior.
Report security issues using SECURITY.md instead of posting exploit details.
